description: This file defines asynchronous dependency functions for a FastAPI application, using Depends for dependency injection. It includes dependencies that generate, yield, and close resources in a sequence.

methods.name: dependency_a()
methods.description: Defines an async dependency that generates and closes a resource, used as a dependency in FastAPI routes.

methods.name: dependency_b(dep_a=Depends(dependency_a))
methods.description: Defines an async dependency that depends on dependency_a, generates and closes another resource.

methods.name: dependency_c(dep_b=Depends(dependency_b))
methods.description: Defines an async dependency that depends on dependency_b, generates and closes a third resource.
